subject: Covariate to adjust by in gl.PCoA

messages.author: eeac0a812b34e9b2
messages.subject: Covariate to adjust by in gl.PCoA
parts:
Hi,
I was wondering if there is a way to use a variable as a covariate to adjust for the PCA with gl.PCoA. I performed a PCA of allelic frequencies in a human population sample genotyped for several SNPs and I would like to adjust by a phenotype. Could you tell me if there is any way to do that? It would be very helpful.
Thanks in advance!
Iriel
